stories.title: Charter plane crashes in western Alaska, killing all 8 aboard
new_facts: Names crash site as Cape Newenham Long Range Radar Site Airport, ~450 miles west of Anchorage
Identifies aircraft as a Cessna 441 operated by a private charter company
U.S. military confirmed the crash and death toll
Names charter operator as Security Aviation
Plane departed from Anchorage and crashed on approach early Thursday afternoon
Charter plane with 8 aboard crashed Thursday near remote Alaska radar station
NTSB confirmed as investigating agency for the crash
Breakdown of the 8 aboard: two pilots and six passengers
stories.line: A charter plane carrying eight people crashed near a remote military radar site in western Alaska; all aboard died.

stories.title: Monte dei Paschi launches dual takeover bids to reshape Italian banking
new_facts: MPS launches twin takeover bids for Banco BPM and Banca Generali, creating ~€70bn Italian banking giant
Names Intesa Sanpaolo as the rival MPS is challenging with the new €70bn banking pole
Details bid values: €25.3bn for Banco BPM (no premium), €8.7bn for Banca Generali, €34bn total, plus €4bn dividend and MPS quote
stories.line: Italian bank Monte dei Paschi bids to acquire two rivals, creating a 70-billion-euro banking group that would challenge market leader Intesa.

stories.title: Python receives chemotherapy in first-ever treatment of its kind for snakes
new_facts: 40kg, 23-year-old reticulated python became first snake treated with electrochemotherapy for cancer, now recovering well.
stories.line: A 40-kilogram python in a UK zoo received chemotherapy for cancer, marking the first snake treated with a human cancer drug.

stories.title: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers found guilty in Hong Kong of ‘inciting subversion’
new_facts: First report of guilty verdict; includes quote from activist group calling judicial system 'twisted'.
States three activists (not two) were accused of inciting subversion of state power.
Names defendants Lee Cheuk-yan (69) and Chow Hang-tung (41), leaders of Hong Kong Alliance, and cites the 2020 national security law and incitement charge wording.

stories.title: Retail sales fall for first time in three months
new_facts: ONS reports UK retail sales volumes fell 0.5% in July vs June.
First sales fall in three months; World Cup drink spending partly offset clothing decline.
stories.line: U.S. retail sales declined in July, the first drop in three months, driven by falling clothing purchases.
